blocks.text: Jab koi cheez garam ki jaye to woh chamakne lagti aur shuaon ki shakal mein tawanai chhorti hai. Yeh shua sirf cheez ke darja hararat par munhasir hai, us ke maddah ya shakal par nahi. Darja hararat barhne par us ka rang madham surkh se tez peela aur phir safed hota hai, jo dikhata hai ke shua lambi wavelengths (infrared) se chhoti (ultraviolet) ki taraf khisak rahi hai. Asal cheezein tamam shuaein mukammal jazb ya kharij nahi karti, is liye scientists aik misali cheez, blackbody, farz karte hain.

blocks.title: Blackbody
blocks.text: Blackbody aisi cheez hai jo us par parne wali tamam shuaein jazb karti aur tamam wavelengths par mukammal shuaein kharij bhi karti hai.

Blackbody ki achhi haqeeqi misal chhote soorakh aur kaali (kalikh lagi) andaruni deewaron wala khokhla gaar (cavity) hai (Fig 21.3). Soorakh se andar aane wali shua andar takrati rehti aur qaid ho jati hai. Agar gaar kafi zyada darja hararat tak garam ki jaye to soorakh tamam wavelengths ki shuaein kharij karta hai: blackbody radiation. Is ka naqsha sirf darja hararat par munhasir hai, aur darja hararat barhne par kharij tawanai barhti hai. Wavelength ke muqable shiddat ka graph (Fig 21.4) dikhata hai ke darja hararat barhne par chotti chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisakti hai: garam blackbodies chhoti wavelengths par zyada tawanai kharij karti hain.
Sitare blackbody radiators ke taur par

Sooraj jaise sitare blackbody radiators ki tarah bartao karte hain. Yeh nuclear fusion se apni tawanai banate, jo electromagnetic shuaon ki shakal mein khala mein phailti aur wavelengths ki wasee had par musalsal spectrum banati hai, jo blackbody spectrum jaisa hai. Spectrum parh kar scientists sitare ki satah ka darja hararat andaza laga sakte hain; har sitare ka apna spectrum aur is liye apna satah ka darja hararat hai.

blocks.title: Wien ka displacement qanoon
blocks.text: Woh wavelength lambda_max jis par blackbody sab se zyada shiddat se shuaein kharij karti hai us ke satah ke darja hararat T ke ulat mutanasib hai: lambda_max, 1/T ke mutanasib, ya lambda_max T = b (21.3), jahan b Wien ka constant, 2.9 x 10^-3 m K, hai.

Blackbody ka darja hararat barhne par us ki chotti ki wavelength chhoti qeematon ki taraf khisakti hai: garam cheezein chhoti wavelengths par sab se tez kharij karti hain (neeli ya banafshi nazar aati), thandi lambi wavelengths par (surkh ya infrared). Yeh khisakna garam cheezon ka rang badalna samjhata aur sitaron ka darja hararat maloom karne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.title: Wien ke constant ki ikai
blocks.text: Kitab b = 2.9 x 10^-3 'mK' likhti hai; ikai metre kelvin (m K) hai, millikelvin nahi.

blocks.alt: Baen: chhote khala (soorakh) wala halqa-numa gaar; neeli shua andar aa kar jazb hone tak takrati rehti. Daen: 5000, 4000, 3000 aur 2000 K ke liye 0 se 3 micrometre wavelength ke muqable shiddat ke graphs; har curve ki aik chotti, 5000 K ka sab se ooncha aur chotti nazar aane wali patti mein, aur dashed purple lakeer chotiyon ko jorti, jo darja hararat girne par lambi wavelengths ki taraf jati; lambda_max T = b = 2.9 x 10^-3 m K.
blocks.caption: Blackbody radiation (Figs 21.3 aur 21.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Garam jism har wavelength par kaheen zyada shuaein deta hai, aur us ki chotti chhoti, neeli wavelengths ki taraf jati hai. Sitare ke spectrum ki chotti ki wavelength parh kar us ka satah ka darja hararat milta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Blackbody shuaon ka mukammal jazb aur kharij karne wala hai. Cosmic microwave background radiation ka spectrum taqreeban mukammal blackbody spectrum hai, aur hamare jism bhi infrared mein blackbody shuaein kharij karte hain, isi liye night-vision cameras andhere mein hamein pakar lete hain. (Kitab microwave oven bhi ginti hai, lekin oven ki microwaves magnetron se aik frequency par aati hain, blackbody ke ikhraj se nahi.)

Aik sitare ka satah ka darja hararat 6000 K aur us ki shuaon ki chotti ki wavelength 480 nm hai. Doosre sitare ki chotti ki wavelength 320 nm hai. Us ka satah ka darja hararat maloom karein. Hal: lambda_max T = b, is liye lambda_max1 T1 = lambda_max2 T2 aur T2 = lambda_max1 T1 / lambda_max2 = (480 x 10^-9 m x 6000 K)/(320 x 10^-9 m) = 9000 K.

blocks.prompt: Do cheezein mukhtalif darja hararat tak garam ki jati hain. Aik surkh-garam aur doosri safed-garam chamakti hai. Kaun zyada garam hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Safed-garam: is ki chotti chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisak gayi hai, is liye yeh poori nazar aane wali had mein tez kharij karti (safed), jab ke surkh-garam zyada tar lambi (surkh) wavelengths par kharij karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar sitare ki chotti ki wavelength chhoti ho to yeh us ke darja hararat ke bare mein kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh zyada garam hai, kyunke lambda_max T = constant.

items: Blackbody: tamam shuaein jazb aur tamam wavelengths kharij; chhote soorakh wala gaar.
T barhne par chotti chhoti wavelength ki taraf.
Wien: lambda_max T = 2.9 x 10^-3 m K; sitare blackbodies jaise.
